description: Source code for an EEPROM driver implementation in an AUTOSAR-based Arctic Core platform, handling SPI communication, read/write/compare operations, and job processing.

methods.name: Eep_AsyncTransmit
methods.description: Performs asynchronous SPI transmit for EEPROM jobs.

methods.name: Spi_ConvertToSpiAddr
methods.description: Converts EEPROM address to SPI data format.

methods.name: Eep_WREN
methods.description: Enables write operations on EEPROM via SPI.

methods.name: Eep_WRDI
methods.description: Disables write operations on EEPROM via SPI.

methods.name: Eep_ReadStatusReg
methods.description: Reads the status register from EEPROM.

methods.name: Eep_Init
methods.description: Initializes the EEPROM driver with configuration.

methods.name: Eep_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the operational mode (normal/fast) for EEPROM.

methods.name: Eep_Read
methods.description: Prepares a read job from EEPROM.

methods.name: Eep_Erase
methods.description: Stub for erase operation, not implemented.

methods.name: Eep_Write
methods.description: Prepares a write job to EEPROM.

methods.name: Eep_Compare
methods.description: Prepares a compare job to verify EEPROM contents.

methods.name: Eep_ProcessJob
methods.description: Processes current EEPROM job, handling SPI communication.

methods.name: Eep_MainFunction
methods.description: Main processing loop for ongoing EEPROM jobs.
